scope: Chapters 14-26 visual lessons; full atlas pages 35-60; book contact sheets 08-14

findings.finding: Diagonal swimlane connectors intersect event-label text. On 24B, the paths cross Persist approved, Drop response; crash worker, and Return original; 15A has the same routing pattern near Send INC-77 and Reply: cluster.
findings.fix: Route connectors through inter-event gutters using orthogonal elbows, or put event labels on opaque backgrounds with a clear margin. Keep numbered events and wait boundaries unambiguous. Re-render both pages and inspect at full size.

findings.finding: The vertical 95% dashed gate extends through the right-aligned interval-value labels below the whiskers, including the 100.0% upper-bound text. The actual interval data and proportional scale are correct.
findings.fix: Move numeric labels into a dedicated text gutter, give them an opaque background, or break the gate line around their text bounds. Preserve the shared 0-100% axis and the exact calculated interval values.

findings.finding: The title The right scope on the wrong destination pass is awkward and its final word pass can be mistaken for an outcome, while the lesson demonstrates rejection.
findings.fix: Use Right scope, wrong audience, or another short title that names the failed audience check.

findings.finding: Each page contains only one continuation paragraph of approximately 100 layout points, leaving over 80% of the body frame unused immediately before a full-page visual lab. Full-size inspection confirms the pages are not missing images; they are pagination stragglers.
findings.fix: Rebalance the preceding prose/figure or prose/code page, or keep each explanatory tail with its preceding unit before the lab. Preserve paragraph order and the full-page lesson contract; avoid shrinking text solely to fill the page.

clean_findings: All 26 atlas pages inspected individually: titles, introductions, reading cues, prediction questions, takeaways, assumptions and answer-link labels remain visible.
No clipping, missing labels, split lesson panels or accidental blank pages found in the assigned atlas range.
Packet check statuses, snapshot changed-cell highlights, matrix decisions, ledger balances and evidence-link endpoints agree with their lesson data.
Ledger bars preserve the 0.70, 0.82, 0.42 and 0.47 balances; calibration bars preserve 64, 6, 9 and 21 counts.
Wilson whiskers, point estimates, gate placement and printed intervals agree with the calculated data; the remaining issue is guide-line placement behind labels.
Book contact sheets 08-14 show intact visual units and consistent headers/footers; no other obvious clipping or blank pages observed at contact-sheet resolution.
limitations: Book flow review used contact sheets covering PDF pages 253-504, with full-size checks of the two sparse pages; ordinary book body text was not proofread at full size throughout.
This report describes the supplied final-atlas/final-book images. Renderer fixes made concurrently require targeted re-render verification.
